title: Gold Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?
summary: For a Gold Account, the document states the APY is 5.5% and interest compounds daily, so each day’s interest accrues based on your current balance and prior accrued interest. Interest is credited monthly and appears as a separate line item on your statement after each monthly cycle closes.
